text:
nina-marketing: Quick thread  proposal for the post-launch newsletter sequence. Wanted to avoid the congestion we saw last quarter where launch email + benchmark invite + webinar all landed same week. Notes + ask: split and introduce behavioral suppression.
omar-growth: Good call. We lost ~2.1% net MRR from unsub spike after that week. Which audiences are high-risk?
carla-analytics: Pulled cohort overlaps. Short summary: newcomers from paid trials and conference lead lists were getting 3 sends in 7 days. SQL snippet:
```sql
SELECT source, count(DISTINCT user_id) as users, sum(case when received='welcome_v3' then 1 else 0 end) as welcome_count,
  sum(case when received='bench_launch' then 1 else 0 end) as bench_count,
  sum(case when received='webinar_invite' then 1 else 0 end) as webinar_count
FROM email_events
WHERE sent_at BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY users DESC;
```
lee-ops: Ops request: any changes must pass the blackout window for paying customers (we have a 24h no-email around billing). Keep that in mind.
zack-sales: Also flag anyone with active trial value > $5000 ARR for sales-first contact. Don't want them to be cagey with product emails.
nina-marketing: Proposed sequence (for new users): Day 0 = welcome; Day 3 = product tips (soft); Day 8 = benchmark narrative (only if not recently engaged); Day 14 = webinar invite (only if not sales-contacted).
omar-growth: Also propose a microsegment for "conference-led" audience: move benchmark to Day 10 due to recency bias. Test: benchmark Day 8 vs Day 10 for that cohort. 20% of that cohort held as control.
carla-analytics: I'll generate suppression lists: criteria = opened_any_email_in_last_72h OR triggered_event('first_success') in 72h. Also add suppression: unsubscribed_flag and email_bounced.
lee-ops: For infra: we need to create a new SendGrid suppression list name "post_launch_recent_engaged" and ensure it's accessible by Braze connector. I'll scope the IAM for the service account.
zack-sales: Confirming: sales_contacted flag is populated by SFDC webhook to our users table. I'll coordinate with platform to ensure near-real-time sync.
nina-marketing: A/B test plan for launch week: Group A (current cadence), Group B (new staggered cadence), N=10k each across paid and organic. Primary metrics: 7-day unsub rate, 7-day reg for benchmark, 14-day webinar CTR. Secondary: demo requests.
nina-marketing: Folks, can we own responsibilities? Omar: A/B orchestration + holdout. Carla: suppression lists + cohort exports. Lee: SendGrid suppression config + IAM. Zack: SFDC flag check. I'll schedule rollout for next Monday.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: marketing/email-campaigns/post-launch-stagger-v1 at 2026-03-23T03:30:00Z (dry-run enabled)
carla-analytics: Uploaded cohort CSV to the Notion page and linked to the campaign doc. Shared counts: paid_new = 11,478; organic_new = 7,312; conference = 2,004.
omar-growth: I'll create the sample split and post the randomization seed in the doc. Nina please confirm the sample size thresholds.
nina-marketing: Confirmed. Let's reconvene next Tue in sync. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
